interface.signature: def canMeasureWater(x: int, y: int, z: int) -> bool:

preconditions.expression: isinstance(x, int) and isinstance(y, int) and isinstance(z, int)
preconditions.description: x, y, and z are integers representing jug capacities and target volume.
Capacities and target volume are non-negative.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (z == 0 or (z <= x + y and z % math.gcd(x, y) == 0))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if z is 0, or z is at most the sum of capacities and is a multiple of the greatest common divisor of x and y.
